toolchain.coverageEncoding: Constant-white emission; Non-Color RGB8 floor(255 * coverage), exact 255 only for full coverage; same UV, samples, clear and margin
toolchain.normalConvention: Blender target UV V inverted to glTF; baked normal green inverted
toolchain.sourceBasis: Explicit GLB tangent, W and normal corner attributes; source normal scale baked once
toolchain.sourceFallback: Preserves declared portable-tangent fallback; does not recover an undefined original UV basis
toolchain.sourceSampler: Linear repeat U / clamp V; V clamped per-image to half-texel interval before Blender repeat lookup
toolchain.uvAlgorithm: Smart Project 66 degrees, area weight .5, island margin .018

nativeSource.colorPolicy: Linear blend of original face texture and filtered cervical pigment using canonical rest-position mask
